outcome: The year's election statements ride on the CMP-2 accountant packet: the de minimis safe harbor statement (business name, address, EIN last-4, the rule-book per-item limit) once the year's capitalization policy is signed; the bonus depreciation elect-out statement for any property class the owner or accountant has chosen for the year; and the Section 195 note with the business-began date and start-up totals — all with the return due date and the extension date. A Year-end tax planning To do appears every November 15 with the year's facts (estimated profit, retirement room, mid-quarter status, equipment information — never advice to buy — and the questions for the CPA). The accountant can edit the elect-out choice; every change is audited under their own name and listed for the owner.
acceptance: Election statements (de minimis, bonus elect-out, §195 note) on the accountant packet with due and extension dates (card acceptance 1)
November 15 year-end planning To do with the listed facts (information, never advice to buy) (card acceptance 2)
Accountant can edit; changes listed for Chris; ci green; every review comment read (card acceptance 3)
invariants: No full tax ID ever enters a packet snapshot: filings' assertNoFullTaxId stands; statements carry the EIN's last 4 only (Lane 5 compliance rule; profile exposes einLast4 only)
The de minimis statement rides only when the year's capitalization policy is SIGNED; an unsigned year shows a plain not-included line instead of a silent gap
Every number comes from the rule book or the books (per-item limit from us.de_minimis_per_item; class lives from us.class_life_months) — no dollar or 4-digit literals in the taxben module (lint test)
The elect-out choice is per tax year, defaults to none chosen, and never rewrites a recorded purchase decision (TAXBEN-1 doctrine: decisions keep the reason and rule values they were made under)
The November 15 To do states facts and questions only — it never advises buying equipment or making a contribution
Accountant edits go through one narrow audited save (taxben.elections.save); the owner-only tax-year facts save is NOT widened
Money stays integer cents; times are Denver business dates
